audience: billing and finance teams who run usage-based billing in Orb

useCases.title: Check the metered usage of a subscription
useCases.text: The AI reads the metered usage of a subscription over a timeframe you give, plus the subscription itself. You see how much a customer used.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and their customers
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by customer, subscription or status and reads one invoice. You see which customers still owe.

useCases.title: Preview the next invoice of a subscription
useCases.text: The AI fetches the upcoming draft invoice for a subscription, so you can check the amounts before it is issued.

useCases.title: See the costs of a customer or subscription
useCases.text: The AI reads the costs a customer or a subscription incurred over a timeframe and compares them.

useCases.title: Check a customer's credit balance and ledger
useCases.text: The AI reads a customer's credit balances by currency and the credit ledger, so you can see how credits were added and used.

useCases.title: Create a customer or update their details
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by id or external id, creates a new one with name and email, or changes details of an existing one.
